note: A live run needs a tracker and gh, so these evals isolate what pi-tasks depends on: evidence honesty and the outcome protocol on the final lines. Each scenario file records the (simulated) investigation; the agent reports it.

evals.name: issue-filed-with-chain
evals.prompt: You ran the /issue-research workflow for 'Investigate why the nightly build has failed 3 of the last 5 runs'. The investigation record is in scenario.txt. Write the final message you would end the session with.
evals.expected_output: A wrap-up ending with 'ISSUE: <url> — <title>' for the filed issue, a NEXT: line chaining the fix via /plan-to-pr with the issue URL, then DONE — issues don't gate, so the status is done, not review.
assertions: Contains an 'ISSUE: <url> — <title>' line with the exact URL from the scenario
Contains a 'NEXT:' line that names /plan-to-pr and carries the issue URL
Ends with DONE — the filed issue does not put the task in a blocked or review state
Contains no 'PR:' line and no URLs not present in the scenario
Keeps verified findings and suspicions distinguishable in the summary, as the scenario does

evals.name: duplicate-found
evals.prompt: You ran /issue-research on 'File an issue for the login timeout users are reporting'. scenario.txt records the investigation — including what the tracker search turned up. Write your final session message.
evals.expected_output: Reports that an existing issue covers it and that the new evidence was added as a comment there; the ISSUE: line points at the existing issue; no second issue filed; DONE.
assertions: Does not report filing a new issue — the existing issue from the tracker search is the one referenced
The 'ISSUE:' line carries the existing issue's URL from the scenario
States that the reproduction evidence was added as a comment on the existing issue

evals.name: no-evidence-blocked
evals.prompt: You ran /issue-research on 'Investigate the crash a customer reported in the export flow'. scenario.txt has the record — you could not reproduce or find any trace of it. Write your final session message.
evals.expected_output: BLOCKED: no reproduction, no log evidence, and the report lacks version/OS details — with the concrete asks that would unblock (customer's app version, export format, a log bundle). No issue filed on speculation.
assertions: Reports BLOCKED rather than filing a speculative issue
Lists the specific missing information that would unblock the research
Contains no 'ISSUE:' line and no invented URL
